versions.statuteQuote: Authorizes any person to confess judgment on a claim arising out of the rental agreement

summaryForModel: A lease cannot let anyone confess judgment against the tenant (admit liability on the tenant's behalf so the landlord gets a judgment without a hearing). Such a clause is unenforceable.
paraphraseExamples: Tenant appoints Landlord as attorney-in-fact to confess judgment against Tenant for any unpaid rent.
Tenant consents to entry of judgment without notice or hearing for any amount due under this lease.
tenantExplanation: A lease can't let your landlord get a court judgment against you without you having a chance to respond. This clause can't be enforced.
action: You can ask your landlord to remove this clause before you sign.
